name: Gigachad
look: A moody black-and-white photo of a shirtless, extremely muscular man with a sharp jawline, a dark beard and swept-back hair. He sits on a wooden chair with his forearms resting on his knees and turns his head to gaze off to the side.
use: Stands for the ultimate confident, unbothered person. Captions label him as someone who does a thing boldly, without shame or overthinking, often in contrast to people who agonize over the same choice.
slots: the bold, unbothered person or choice (caption above or below)
examples: Me ordering the same meal every time without opening the menu
The guy who replies to emails the same day
